title: Machine learning on CAGIB components predicts in-hospital death in cirrhotic GI bleeding
summary: In a prospective international multicentre study of 2467 cirrhotic patients with acute gastrointestinal bleeding, models built on the CAGIB score components were compared. The CAGIB score had a training AUC of 0.789 and the best model, a least squares support vector machine regression, reached 0.986, with risk groups showing in-hospital mortality of 0.38%, 2.22% and 64.37%.
ai_technology: Machine-learning models including least squares support vector machine regression on CAGIB score components
organization: General Hospital of Northern Theater Command; Peking University
